partner.name: Westside Muralist
partner.line: Every Dreamtone LA mural runs through Westside Muralist.
partner.body: Westside Muralist is our exclusive mural partner. They work with a bench of Los Angeles mural and graffiti artists on custom installations for companies across the city. We design to the room and film the build; Westside puts it on the wall. One point of contact, one price, one schedule.

galleryBody: A sample of the range — portraiture, lettering, full building wraps, and painted objects. Every wall below was designed, painted, and documented by the partnership.

gallery.title: Portrait with halo
gallery.note: Black-and-grey portraiture at scale, with a hand-sprayed halo and an intentional run-down on raw concrete.

gallery.title: Wonder Dirty Six
gallery.note: Full-wall lettering and portrait on a lavender field of line-drawn poppies. Colour-forward and built to be photographed.

gallery.title: Painted art car
gallery.note: Hand-painted livery across an air-cooled 911 — houndstooth, colour blocking, and a checker flag panel.

gallery.title: Corner building wrap
gallery.note: A whole building taken as one canvas — desert palette, hawk, coyote, and a night sky carried around the corner.
